news.text: #Juve, It Is Time To RestartToday #NEC at 9 PM#Spalletti with #Nico, #Conceicao and #Woltemade, #Grabara makes his debut. "The fans are dreaming of #Conte? I won't disappoint #Carnevali".[Front Page Gazzetta dello Sport]
#Spalletti: "#Conte? Pressure is medicine"At 9 PM, #NEC Nijmegen will be there. Lucio: "We must be up to #Juve's standards, I won't disappoint #Carnevali".[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

"#JUVE, YOU'LL SEE THAT I'LL IMPROVE"At 9 PM: #Juve-#NEC#Spalletti proudly hits back at #Carnevali and makes ironic remarks about the #Conte speculationThe bianconero coach cannot fail his cup debut. "I won't disappoint the director, I will become what he desires. #Conte? Everyone backs who they want: I back the team in training. I remain convinced that we are strong: we lost one match! The Dutch play an innovative and surprising football. #McKennie is definitely playing. And #Gatti". Chances also for #Grabara and #Woltemade. #Kalulu: "You'll see, #Kolo will break his drought".[Front Page TuttoSport]
Predicted lineup via Gazzetta dello Sport

🧐⁉️ "#Yildiz is definitely the #Juventus player who will have the most requests, he already had some: #Arsenal made a move for him. However, it is clear that the bianconeri will do everything they can to keep him. The other could be #Bremer, even though in the end no one stepped forward in a decisive manner for him, and he has always shown his desire to stay in Turin."[Di Marzio - Sky Sport via @juventusinsidernews]
🔴 Probable formation #Juventus: Vicario; Gatti, Bremer, Lucumi; Kalulu, Douglas Luiz, Sarr, Celik; McKennie, Kolo Muani; Woltemade.[Sky Sport via @juventusinsidernews]
Possible formation:JUVENTUS (3-4-2-1): Vicario; Gatti, Bremer, Lucumi; Kalulu, Sarr, Douglas Luiz, Celik; Mckennie, Kolo Muani; Woltemade.Coach. Spalletti[Alfredo Pedulla]
🔴⚪️🇨🇦 Jonathan David has now scored 2 goals for Atlético Madrid since joining from Juventus on loan… and delivered an assist.[Fabrizio Romano]

👨‍🦲✅ "#Spalletti remains at the helm of #Juventus: the club's message, both publicly and privately, is very clear. On #Conte, if he wanted to take on other projects, even abroad like #Fenerbahce, he would have had the opportunity to do so, but he refused because he's waiting for the right project. For now, however, I don't feel like saying anything else, also out of respect for the bianconero coach who must still be left alone to do his work."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]
Manaka Hayashi signs for Juventus! ✍️Welcome, Manaka! 🇯🇵[Juventus]

JUVENTUS AND THE EXPECTATIONS"I’m not surprised by the controversy. We know we have pressing matters. We must win this match, but that’s not all.We must show that we are Juventus. We must prove that we deserve the position we’re in and that we can stay there. All our energy must be focused solely on that. I’m not interested in what people say about me. I’ve been through plenty of situations like this in my career."[Juventus]

SPALLETTI AND KALULU LOOK AHEAD TO JUVENTUS VS NECThe Men’s First Team begin their Europa League campaign with a League Phase match against NEC Nijmegen on Thursday, September 16. Coach Luciano Spalletti and defender Pierre Kalulu spoke to the press ahead of the first League Phase match of the campaign at the Allianz Stadium.PIERRE KALULUTHE DESIRE TO BOUNCE BACK“Among ourselves, we’re always focused on getting revenge in the next game, because that’s the only one that matters. You can’t change the past, you can only influence the future. So there’s a strong desire to play well tomorrow. We reviewed the game against Sassuolo and identified our mistakes. 🇮🇹🧤 #Juventus continues to closely monitor the mercato of young Italian talents and, for the goalkeeper of the future, #Palmisani stands at the top of the list: the idea is to move in advance, perhaps as early as January, to beat out competition that is destined to increase. The strategy would be to sign him and leave him at #Frosinone until June. The deal is also favored by the good relations between #Carnevali, #Massara and the agent.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]

🇵🇱🧤 #Grabara could start against #NEC: #Spalletti is considering a rotation between the posts, without it being any sort of disapproval for #Vicario. The Pole is impressing due to his footwork, explosiveness and quality.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]

🇫🇷👀 "#Juventus is increasingly impressed by #Bakola: they would have offered a loan with an obligation to buy for €18M during the final hours of the mercato, but #Sassuolo didn't even take it into consideration because they are convinced he could leave in January for €30/40M. There is also a risk that the Premier League might step in, but if the bianconeri continue to face problems in midfield, another attempt could be made in the winter."[Nicolò Schira - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]
Pierre #Kalulu will be the one speaking alongside #Spalletti at the #JuveNEC eve press conference. 🎙️Appointment at 3:00 PM@junews24com[Marco Baridon]

Ahead of #JuveNEC, 3️⃣ updates from the eve training session (images on @junews24com) #McKennie and #Cambiaso confirmed to be training with the group. Another breath of fresh air for the flanks and midfield. #Owusu, #Elimoghale and #Pagnucco are present.#Grabara was particularly tested. A first chance to start?[Marco Baridon]
